coverage.golden: RFC 8439 §2.3 serialize() — chacha20_golden.py, pinned by the §2.3.2 vector; no GNU Radio counterpart
coverage.anchors: the sixteen §2.3.2 state words as hi/lo halves -> the RFC's 64 keystream bytes, bit-exact IN ORDER on chip
coverage.rate: 1:2 (2 half-words in -> 4 byte-words out; burst on the lo trigger; a trailing hi half is held, emitting nothing)
coverage.saturated: queue_words_physical back-to-back == per-sample (count and values), RFC burst + 2 random seeds
coverage.mid_chain: Delay(2) -> serializer -> Delay(1) hand-placed on one chip, all nets routed, composed reference exact — plain routed egress, mid-chain friendly (INV-66)
coverage.orientation: all 8 D4 on the full burst + the shared suite
coverage.batch: odd batch -> batch_reset_writes -> RFC batch exact (reset_per_batch on hi+par)
coverage.mutation_onchip: 3 real mutants placed+routed+built+run: parity swapped / byte order reversed (== big-endian, asserted) / reset_per_batch stripped (first batch PASSES, second fails)
coverage.structural: INV-33 overlap gate with INV-4 negative
coverage.stop_reason: read for EVERY chip case; QueueEmpty required
coverage.note: serializes ChaCha20KeystreamBlock's hi/lo half-word stream into RFC 8439 little-endian keystream bytes, one byte per 16-bit word (the data_link convention)
